$Comment: The Great Turkey on the hard way in: the same fight as Harvest_Feast_Great_Turkey_Encounter, a Variant of
this pack's Orbis_Boss_Encounter_Template, with its hard forms and more souls, the way the Headless
Horseman's hard ride sits beside his normal one. It runs in the hard graveyard
(Prefabs/Harvest_Feast/Harvest_Feast_Turkey_Graveyard_Hard.prefab.json), the same place, where the Great
Turkey rises from Harvest_Feast_Great_Turkey_Hard_Marker once players have beaten three waves of souls
around the fountain.
The waves before it rises are GuardWave, ziggfreed-common's Zc_Wave_Chain, set in _ForwardedModifiers
below as on the normal fight: as players arrive (8 seconds on, once the intro camera is done), four hard
Turkey Souls rise on the plaza south of the fountain, 7 blocks north of the fight's entity across 90
degrees, and two at the fountain's north corners, 19 blocks out across 37 degrees. Once the last of a
wave falls, the next rises 3 seconds later; a wave none of which is seen within 3 seconds counts as
beaten. Its Done flag, Orbis_Boss_Waves_Done, is one the template never clears, so once the waves are
beaten they stay beaten after a wipe on the Great Turkey.
What is harder lives in three places. Its _HM roles carry more health (the Great Turkey 1950 against
900, each soul 100 against 45, and a soul's peck 10 against 7), and the Great Turkey's also carries
Harvest_Feast_Great_Turkey_Hard_Mode, which makes every peck hit 40% harder. Its health steps are the
_Hard_Scale effects, 880 per player beyond the first. And _ForwardedModifiers below brings more souls
sooner: four at half its health and three more with its fury at a quarter (the normal fight's are three
and two, at half and a fifth), and through every phase three on the plaza and two at the fountain each
time it loses another fifth (at 80, 60, 40 and 20 percent; the normal fight raises three at 75, 35 and
10). No health packs fall on this fight. The bar shows the game's hard-mode style (BossBarHardMode) and
the hard name.
Its reach is the normal fight's, since both graveyards are one place (that file tells the distances).
Change these with the normal fight's.
Its death pays each credited player Harvest_Feast_Great_Turkey_Daily_Hard (the first hard win each day)
and Harvest_Feast_Great_Turkey_Chase_Hard (the Boss Kill Claim, every hard win), both under
Server/Rewards/Harvest_Feast and counted apart from the normal fight's, so a player can collect both
fights' Claims on the same day; the dungeon pays its hard clear beside them
(ZiggfreedCommon/Dungeons/Harvest_Feast_Turkey_Graveyard_Hard.json). The binding row
ZiggfreedCommon/Encounters/Harvest_Feast_Great_Turkey_Encounter_Hard.json names the fight and keeps its
records apart. The phases reuse the normal fight's macros, flags and moments. This file's name is not a
role's: a script named after a role replaces it.
